questions.q: show = rupees (no brackets). What is show?
options: The function rupees itself; show(29900) calls it
questions.explain: Functions are values. Without brackets you store the function; with brackets you call it.

questions.q: What does @timed above def fetch_prices(...) mean?
options: fetch_prices = timed(fetch_prices): the name now points to the wrapper that timed returned
timed is called on every line of fetch_prices
questions.explain: The @ line is shorthand for that assignment. Callers keep writing fetch_prices(...) and get the wrapped version.

questions.q: A wrapper prints the new price but has no return. What does the decorated function give back?
questions.explain: The wrapper IS what callers now call. A function without return gives back None. Add return result.

questions.q: When does the decorator function itself (timed) run, and when does the wrapper run?
options: timed runs once, when def runs; the wrapper runs on every call
timed runs on every call; the wrapper never runs
questions.explain: Decorating happens at definition time. Each call then goes through the wrapper.

questions.q: Why does @retry(times=3) need one more level of def than @timed?
options: retry(times=3) runs first and must RETURN the actual decorator, which then takes the function
questions.explain: Settings in brackets → retry(times) returns decorator(func) → which returns wrapper(...).

questions.q: (Going deeper) @tag("outer") on top of @tag("inner") on def checkout. Whose 'before' prints first?
options: outer: the top decorator wraps everything, so its before runs first and its after runs last
questions.explain: checkout = outer(inner(checkout)). Like onion layers: outer before, inner before, checkout, inner after, outer after.

questions.q: (Going deeper) Is @functools.lru_cache a good idea on a function that returns live stock?
options: No: it remembers the first answer per argument, so customers would see old stock
questions.explain: Cache answers that never change (like delivery days per pincode in the example), not live data.
